+1 [ICON_Faith] Faith for farms.

+2 [ICON_Faith] Faith for improved Strategic resources.

+2 [ICON_Faith] Faith for Pastures.

+2 [ICON_Faith] Faith for Plantations.
收获一种资源或删除地貌获得等同于其他收益数量25%的 [ICON_Faith] 信仰值。
Harvesting a resource or removing a feature receives [ICON_Faith] Faith equal to 25% of the other yield's quantity.
清除每个蛮族哨站后+200 [ICON_Faith] 信仰值。
+200 [ICON_Faith] Faith for each Barbarian Outpost cleared.
沼泽、 绿洲、泛滥平原+1 [ICON_Faith] 信仰值。
+1 [ICON_Faith] Faith for Marsh, Oasis, and Floodplains.
森林单元格+1 [ICON_Faith] 信仰值。
+1 [ICON_Faith] Faith for forest tiles.
采集奢侈品资源和加成资源的矿山+2 [ICON_Faith] 信仰值。
+2 [ICON_Faith] Faith for Mines over Luxury and Bonus resources.
与圣地区相邻2格范围内的沿河单元格+1 [ICON_Faith] 信仰值。
+1 [ICON_Faith] Faith for tile that is two tiles within a holy site district and is adjacent to a river.
雨林单元格+1 [ICON_Faith] 信仰值。
+1 [ICON_Faith] Faith for Rainforest tiles.
战斗单位处于信奉该宗教的友好城市境内时+5 [ICON_Strength] 战斗力。在您的圣地区域或任何相邻单元格则恢复+20。
Combat units gain +5 [ICON_Strength] Combat Strength when within the borders of friendly cities that follow this Religion. Increases Healing by +20 in your Holy Site district, or any adjacent tiles.
火山土和地热裂缝单元格+3 [ICON_Faith] 信仰值。
+3 [ICON_FAITH] Faith for Geothermal Fissures and Volcanic Soil.

Sea Goddess

+1 [ICON_FAITH] Faith for Coast and Lake tiles.
所有类型的冻土单元格+1 [ICON_Faith] 信仰值。
+1 [ICON_Faith] Faith for any type of Tundra tiles.
所有类型的沙漠单元格+1 [ICON_Faith] 信仰值。
+1 [ICON_Faith] Faith for any type of Desert tiles.

Mountains Goddess
山脉单元格+2 [ICON_Faith] 信仰值。
+2 [ICON_FAITH] Faith for Mountains tiles.
天人合一
Nature Unity
首都3环范围内的单元格+1 [ICON_Faith] 信仰值。
+1 [ICON_FAITH] Faith for tiles within 3 ranges of the Capital.
可以使用 [ICON_Faith] 信仰值购买学院、剧院广场和圣地区域建筑。
May purchase Campus, Holy Site, and Theater Square district buildings with [ICON_Faith] Faith.
圣地（大预言家）、学院（大科学家）、剧院广场（大作家，大艺术家，大音乐家）、商业中心（大商人）、工业区（大工程师）、军营（大将军）、港口（海军统帅）+1 [ICON_GreatPerson] 对应的伟人点数。

+1 [ICON_GreatPerson] Great Person point for Holy Site (Prophet), Campus (Scientist), Theater Square (Writer,Artist,Musician), Commercial hub(Merchant),Industrial zone(Engineer), Encampment (General), Harbor (Admiral) districts.
为军事单位+30% [ICON_Production] 生产力。在圣地区域的8个单元格范围内，每击杀1个战斗单位可获得等同其战斗力100%的 [ICON_Faith] 信仰值加成。
+30% [ICON_Production] Production toward military units. Bonus [ICON_Faith] Faith equal to 100% of the strength of each combat unit killed within 8 tiles of a Holy Site district.
城市人口增长速度提高20%。边境扩张速度提高30%。你的宗教单位在圣地区域（其所属城市须信仰你的主流宗教）或任意相邻单元格中的生命值回复量+10。

City growth rate is 20% higher. Border expansion rate is 30% higher. Increases Healing of your religious units by +10 in Holy Site districts belonging to cities with your majority religion, or any adjacent tiles.
购买传教士、使徒和上师的费用降低25%。允许花费 [ICON_FAITH] 信仰值来生产陆地战斗单位“武僧”。
Missionaries, Apostles, and Gurus are 25% cheaper to purchase. Allows spending [ICON_FAITH] Faith to train Warriors Monks (A land combat unit).
以此为主流宗教的玩家建立城市后，城市初始便拥有此宗教。完成一个圣地后对相邻单元格施放文化炸弹。没有专业化区域的城市建造区域时+100% [ICON_Production] 生产力。

Cities start with this Religion in place if founded by a player who has this as their majority Religion. Culture Bomb adjacent tiles when completing a Holy Site. +100% [ICON_Production] Production toward districts in cities without a specialty district.
邻近城市的宗教传播的压力增加50%，研发出印刷术后增加到100%。宗教传播距离增加50%。
Religious spread from adjacent city pressure is 50% stronger. Boosted to 100% once Printing is researched. Religion spreads to cities 50% further away.
宗教单位忽略地形和地貌的 [ICON_Movement] 移动力消耗。您的宗教压力不会因为神学战斗失败而减少。
Religious units ignore [ICON_Movement] Movement costs of terrain and features. Your Religion's pressure never drops due to losses in Theological Combat.
神圣象征
Sacred symbol
[ICON_GreatWork_Relic] 遗物能产出3倍的 [ICON_Tourism] 旅游业绩。世界奇观能产出2倍的 [ICON_Tourism] 旅游业绩。
[ICON_GreatWork_Relic] Relics have triple yield of [ICON_Tourism] Tourism. World wonders have double yield of [ICON_Tourism] Tourism.
[ICON_GreatWork_Relic] 遗物和 [ICON_GreatWork_HeroRelic] 英雄遗物能产出3倍的 [ICON_Tourism] 旅游业绩。世界奇观能产出2倍的 [ICON_Tourism] 旅游业绩。
[ICON_GreatWork_Relic] Relics and [ICON_GreatWork_HeroRelic] Heroic Relics have triple yield of [ICON_Tourism] Tourism. World wonders have double yield of [ICON_Tourism] Tourism.
圣地区域的 [ICON_Faith] 信仰值相邻加成也提供 [ICON_Gold] 金币。
Holy Site district’s [ICON_Faith] Faith adjacency bonus provides [ICON_Gold] Gold as well.
精神粮食
Manna
圣地区域的 [ICON_Faith] 信仰值相邻加成也提供 [ICON_Food] 食物。
Holy Site district’s [ICON_Faith] Faith adjacency bonus provides [ICON_Food] Food as well.
圣诗
Psalm
圣地区域的 [ICON_Faith] 信仰值相邻加成也提供 [ICON_Culture] 文化值。
Holy Site district’s [ICON_Faith] Faith adjacency bonus provides [ICON_Culture] Culture as well.
圣地区域的 [ICON_Faith] 信仰值相邻加成也提供 [ICON_Science] 科技值。
Holy Site district’s [ICON_Faith] Faith adjacency bonus provides [ICON_Science] Science as well.
允许建造大教堂（+6 [ICON_Faith] 信仰值，拥有1个 [ICON_GREATWORK_RELIGIOUS] 宗教艺术槽位和一个 [ICON_GreatWork_Relic] 遗物槽位）。
Allows construction of Cathedrals (+6 [ICON_Faith] Faith, 1 slot for religious art).
允许创建谒师所（+6 [ICON_Faith] 信仰值，+2 [ICON_Food] 食物，+2 [ICON_Gold] 金币)。
Allows construction of Gurdwaras (+6 [ICON_Faith] Faith, +2 [ICON_Food] Food, +2 [ICON_Gold] Gold).
允许建造礼拜堂（+6 [ICON_Faith] 信仰值，+3 [ICON_Production] 生产力）。
Allows construction of Meeting Houses (+6 [ICON_Faith] Faith, +3 [ICON_Production] Production).
允许建造清真寺（+6 [ICON_Faith] 信仰值）。传教士和使徒的传播次数+1。
Allows construction of Mosques (+6 [ICON_Faith] Faith). Missionaries and Apostles +1 Spread.
允许建造宝塔（+6 [ICON_Faith] 信仰值，每回合+1 [ICON_Favor] 外交支持，+1影响力点数）。
Allows construction of Pagodas (+6 [ICON_Faith] Faith, +1 [ICON_Favor] Diplomatic Favor, +1 Influence point per turn.).
允许建造犹太教堂（+9 [ICON_Faith] 信仰值）。
Allows construction of Synagogues (+9 [ICON_Faith] Faith).
允许建造佛寺（+6 [ICON_Faith] 信仰值，+3 [ICON_Science] 科技值）。
Allows construction of Wats (+6 [ICON_Faith] Faith, +3 [ICON_Science] Science).
允许修建窣堵波（+6 [ICON_Faith] 信仰值，+1 [ICON_Amenities] 宜居度）。
Allows construction of Stupas (+6 [ICON_Faith] Faith, +1 [ICON_Amenities] Amenity).
允许建造拜火神庙（+6 [ICON_Faith] 信仰值，从建造或最后被修复开始每个时代额外+3 [ICON_FAITH] 信仰值。无法被自然灾害掠夺。无法通过电力获得额外加成。）。

Allows construction of Dar-e Mehrs (+6 [ICON_Faith] Faith, +3 additional [ICON_FAITH] Faith for each era since constructed or last repaired. Cannot be pillaged by natural disasters. No additional bonus when powered.).
从建造或最后被修复开始每个时代额外+3 [ICON_FAITH] 信仰值。无法被自然灾害掠夺。无法通过电力获得额外加成。
+3 additional [ICON_FAITH] Faith for each era since constructed or last repaired. Cannot be pillaged by natural disasters. No additional bonus when powered.
十二使徒
Twelve Apostles
每有3个信仰该宗教的信徒，则+1 [ICON_Faith] 信仰值。
+1 [ICON_Faith] Faith for every 3 followers of this Religion.
慈善捐赠
Charitable Contribution
该宗教每有3个信徒则+1 [ICON_Gold] 金币。
+1 [ICON_Gold] Gold for every 3 followers of this Religion.
将一个 [ICON_ENVOY] 使者派遣至城邦后，将对该城邦施加1000点宗教压力。
When you send an [ICON_ENVOY] Envoy to a City-State it adds 1000 Religious pressure to that City-State.
除城邦任务中获得的使者外，城邦首次皈依此宗教时玩家还可在此处额外获得1名 [ICON_Envoy] 使者。每名 [ICON_Envoy] 使者+1 [ICON_Gold] 金币，+1 [ICON_Faith] 信仰值。
+1 [ICON_Envoy] Envoy at each City-State when it first adopts this Religion, in addition to any envoy from a City-State quest. +1 [ICON_Gold] Gold，+1 [ICON_Faith] Faith for each [ICON_Envoy] Envoy.
城市中每个信仰此宗教的居民将使 [ICON_Gold] 金币+1%。
+1% [ICON_Gold] Gold for each citizen following this religion in the city.
城市中每个信仰此宗教的居民将使 [ICON_Faith] 信仰值+1%。
+1% [ICON_Faith] Faith for each citizen following this religion in the city.
城市中每个信仰此宗教的居民将使 [ICON_Culture] 文化值+1%。
+1% [ICON_Culture] Culture for each citizen following this religion in the city.
城市中每个信仰此宗教的居民将使 [ICON_Food] 食物+1%。
+1% [ICON_Food] Food for each citizen following this religion in the city.
城市中每个信仰此宗教的居民将使 [ICON_Production] 生产力+1%。
+1% [ICON_Production] Production for each citizen following this religion in the city.
城市中每个信仰此宗教的居民将使 [ICON_Science] 科技值+1%。
+1% [ICON_Science] Science for each citizen following this religion in the city.
战斗单位处于信奉该宗教的外国城市境内时+10 [ICON_Strength] 战斗力，清除蛮族哨站的单位回复满生命值。
Combat units gain +10 [ICON_Strength] Combat Strength when within the borders of foreign cities that follow this Religion. The unit that cleared the Barbarian Outpost heals +100 HP.
每回合+1 [ICON_Favor] 外交支持，+1影响力点数。
+1 [ICON_Favor] Diplomatic Favor, +1 Influence point per turn.
